versions.title: The Living World
versions.description: Explore deeper biomes, build with shaped blocks and circuits, rest in beds, sail boats, and chart your world.

Worlds: 26 surface biomes, deeper caves, villages and strongholds.
World-space precipitation, immersion effects and brighter torches.
Build and survive: Two-block beds skip night and set your spawn; boats carry you over water.
Stairs, slabs, fluid flow and functional circuit components.
Textured creatures, villager trades, third-person held items and custom skins.
Pixel art: Distinct tops, fronts and sides for utility blocks.
Transparent crossed plants; redesigned tools and item silhouettes.
Corrected bed pillow orientation, blanket seams and side mapping in all four rotations.
Play your way: World atlas with discovery and saved waypoints; rebindable controls.
Slopwoofer Lullaby with independent music volume and frequency.
Launcher discovers new versions automatically and keeps installed versions available offline.
Known limitations: Development snapshot; finite creature roster and Slopcraft circuit rules.
Detailed blocks load within 2–12 chunks; distant landscapes reach 32 chunks.
macOS is ad-hoc signed without notarization; Windows builds are unsigned.

versions.title: Original 0.1 archive
versions.verification: Native title and world smoke on macOS and Windows; original gameplay and saves retained. Launcher name/skin handoff was added in later versions.
